mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTICE_NUM, n.TEAM_NUM, n.USER_NUM, n.TITLE, n.IS_FIXED, n.REG_DATE, n.VIEW_COUNT, u.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME FROM NOTICE n JOIN USERS u ON n.USER_NUM = u.USER_NUM WHERE n.TEAM_NUM = #{teamNum} ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.IS_FIXED = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, n.REG_DATE DESC, n.NOTICE_NUM DESC

SELECT n.NOTICE_NUM, n.TEAM_NUM, n.USER_NUM, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.IS_FIXED, n.REG_DATE, n.VIEW_COUNT, u.USER_NAME AS WRITER_NAME FROM NOTICE n JOIN USERS u ON n.USER_NUM = u.USER_NUM WHERE n.NOTICE_NUM = #{noticeNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE (NOTICE_NUM, TEAM_NUM, USER_NUM, TITLE, CONTENT, IS_FIXED, REG_DATE, VIEW_COUNT) VALUES (SEQ_NOTICE.NEXTVAL, #{team_num}, #{user_num}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{is_fixed, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 0)
